turns.user: I validated a 30-minute mobile ticket at 10:00.
turns.agent:
If your last transfer to another line was validated before 10:30, you may finish that final ride even if it continues past 10:30. The 30-minute mobile ticket allows transfers on covered lines within its time window; validate at the start and when changing lines, except between metro lines.

This is from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not live verification. See BKK’s 30-minute ticket page for current terms. If you mean a transfer you’re about to make, tell me when and which lines; I can help interpret the timing.

turns.user: Can I transfer to another tram at 10:31 using that same ticket?
turns.agent:
No—not based on the 30-minute transfer rule in the snapshot. A transfer to another tram at 10:31 is after the ticket’s 10:30 window, so you shouldn’t rely on that ticket for the new ride. The rule allowing you to finish a ride beyond the window applies only when the final transfer took place before the window ended.

See BKK’s 30-minute ticket page for current terms; this advice reflects the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not live verification.
